annotations.title: Find SDSs for an inventory list

description: Look up the safety data sheet (SDS) for a LIST of workplace chemicals or products at once, e.g. the product-name column of a chemical inventory spreadsheet. Returns one row per product: whether a manufacturer-hosted SDS PDF was found (a third-party copy is marked as such), the manufacturer, the revision date printed on the sheet, and the PDF link, using the same rules as find_safety_data_sheet (an unidentifiable product is reported as not found, never guessed). Up to 10 products per call; call again for the rest. For up to 5 products with a manufacturer-hosted SDS it also lists a free, no-signup printable GHS secondary-container label link. With language "es" each row also carries the manufacturer's own Spanish SDS link when one was found and read (or says none was found / not checked yet), and the label links open the Spanish label maker. Free, no signup. Use it when someone has several chemicals or an SDS binder/inventory to fill in.

language.description: Optional output language. "es" adds the manufacturer's own Spanish SDS link when one was found and read, and the label elements in the official UN GHS Spanish wording. Default "en".

products.description: Chemical or product names, one per item (max 10 per call; extra items are listed as not looked up).

name: find_sds_for_inventory
title: Find safety data sheets for a chemical inventory list (batch)
